name: Compania Sud Americana de Vapores S.A.
summary: Compañía Sud Americana de Vapores S.A., through its subsidiaries, provides maritime cargo transport services in Latin America. It offers transportation services, such as maritime carriage of liquid and solid bulk cargoes, refrigerated cargo, and heavy equipment. The company was founded in 1872 and is based in Las Condes, Chile. Compañía Sud Americana de Vapores S.A. is a subsidiary of Quiñenco S.A.
